title: Quality Assurance (QA) services for monitoring the construction activities during the Phase 7 of the ELT Dome and Main Structure (DMS) project
description: Division: DOP/ELT. Call for tender (CFT) covering the monitoring construction activities during the On-Site Erection and Commissioning phase of the ESO’s Extremely Large Telescope (ELT) Dome and Main Structure (DMS) Project. This phase covers the complete erection of the Dome and Main Structure, furnished and commissioned to the level at which the DMS can undergo Acceptance Testing with ESO. It encompasses all mechanical, alignment, electrical, hydraulic, and commissioning activities for installing and delivering an operational DMS. The scope of services of the QA consultant is the verification of the conformity with the design documentation during the construction and the control of the quality of the execution of the erection activities by the DMS Contractor. The CFT is scheduled to be issued in Q4/2022 to potential suppliers in Chile. The service will cover a firm duration of three years and include an option for extension on a year by year basis, for an initial period of two years (i.e. a total duration of five years) and if needed for an additional period up to the full completion of Phase 7 of the ELT DMS project. The contract is expected to be awarded in Q2/2023, to the Bidder, which has submitted a fully compliant tender and offers the best value for money for ESO taking into account the quality and price of the offer.
